purpose: Complete generated AAA asset matrix for v1-v5 and tier-1 through tier-5: visuals, animations, audio, motion CSS, docs receipts.
warning: Quest 2 physical proof is not asserted by these assets. Manual Quest Browser verification remains required.

tiers.name: Tier 1 — Public Spatial Shell
tiers.intent: Home, world entry, sky/ground threshold, orb, avatar, first impression.

tiers.name: Tier 2 — Memory Realms
tiers.intent: Life Map, Focus, Replay, Mirror, Passport, Status, Location Map.

tiers.name: Tier 3 — XR / Quest / AR
tiers.intent: Quest Browser proof layer, WebXR fallback, AR/VR readiness.

tiers.name: Tier 4 — Autonomous Council
tiers.intent: Private AI workforce, council floor, life operations, agents.

tiers.name: Tier 5 — Governance / Legacy
tiers.intent: Consent, provenance, private-by-default, legacy, audit layer.
